title: Bitcoin slips under $60K after $6.8B options expiry | Weekend Brief
caption:
bitcoin's thanksgiving bounce faded: from ~$62,200 back to ~$59,700, with a $58,750 low 📉 eth ~$1,664, sol ~$71.70. ~$458m liquidated in 24h, mostly longs. ~$6.8b in options expired friday and btc dropped at the wall street open. friday's etf flows aren't out yet; november outflows are a record $5.39b. next week: strategy leaves msci indexes mon, us jobs report fri, fed dec 9. levels to watch: $62k, $58.5k. not financial advice. what's your read for the weekend?
